example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নতুন চাকরির খবর শুনে লেজ নাড়তে শুরু করেছে।
বাচ্চারা উৎসবে যাওয়ার জন্য লেজ নাড়ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He started wagging his tail upon hearing the news of the new job.
The kids are wagging their tails in excitement for the festival.
note: This idiom draws from the behavior of dogs wagging their tails to express joy or anticipation, commonly used in Bengali to describe human impatience or eagerness.
